selected_observer: Chosen once via --observer M0 or M1 before the first physical training sample; identical for both heads.
frozen_speed_actor: W44 case-specific checkpoint-014737, deterministic and unchanged
event: one sample after the first walking_requested initializes next_pair or after the actual committed liftoff switches next_pair. Reuse requested_due until handover or terminal.

action.use: P base_due + a * 0.05; same bound for prediction and actual handover. All r60 gates retained.

normalization.different_from_59: Separate per-foot missing, outside, never loaded, recovered, unloaded residual, and loaded. Numeric prediction zero alone is ambiguous.
normalization.recovered_definition: All previously loaded keys under the whole queried footprint are currently unloaded and each has an observed release at least 6.0 s before the latest publication. The W57 saved physical calibration found <=0.2431% of initial q norm after 6 s in its tested release samples. Actual nonzero recovery values are retained. Any shorter known history remains residual; any currently loaded key has priority.
normalization.terminal_stand_due: No actionable next handover while standing. At a physical successor in stand the due-time feature is zero and the observed phase identifies stand.

query.coordinate: First subsequent touchdown of each leg on the controller's published base event schedule. Fixed committed landing first, otherwise search/forecast from current event root and commanded motion within the 0.85 s contact-event forecast. No actual future contact supplied.
query.world_keys: Positive area intersection of the equivalent 0.001 m² sole square with the original world grid; hard-priority edge convention. Unknown cells have virgin state.
query.publication: Use most recent complete M window available at sample time. Retain plan ID/time and independent observer generation/time, plus actual coordinates, area, all source load/release IDs, and predicted target touchdown ID/time.
query.relative_to: Observer publication; all three are independent free-recovery values under no intervening load. They are not the target-event time-to-go or action-conditioned loads.
query.missing: Unpublished/expired target or no completed observer publication yields a missing indicator. Never consume nonfinite WBC residual; the F gate omits that request.

blind.retained: All non-hidden inputs, shared old speed actor, geometry outside and missing indicators, same architecture/optimizer/seed/initial parameters.
blind.zeroed: All 12 explicit free-recovery values and the four material-history categories per leg (virgin/recovered/residual/loaded).

ppo.advantage: Time recursion independently per case; full-sample upstream PPO on all legal requests; post-action gate masks separately counted, not used for outcome-dependent gradient selection.
ppo.natural_end: Original physical failure terminal with zero bootstrap; original E60 time limit truncates with value at actual final observation, episode recursion stops; each collector's 128th transition bootstraps at its successor before loading the next shared policy. No reset at update barrier.
ppo.reward: Original W38 legal-route settlement: 5 Δlegal route − Δt/60 − Δindentation² integral/60 − 0.1 Δloaded slip² integral/60 − 0.01 Δold cap change + 10 Δcompleted legal circuits − 10 physical failure. The old frozen evaluation has no intrinsic-timeout penalty. No added material reward.
ppo.exploration_rng: Index-addressed independent torch CPU generator per distinct requested action: seed=5701*2^32+2*(128*version+case_position)+case_index. Save seeds/positions, optimizer permutations and torch/numpy/CUDA RNG state. Full and blind share initialization and matching RNG rules.

continuation: At nodes require witnessed execution-time or implemented handover-ramp authority in both cases, training queries with observable nonzero residual and corresponding actual reload footprint and measured load/indentation, complete reward/dt/GAE/accounting, and fixed M/P/task/schema/reward. Continue only with training-return trend or between-episode uncertainty that additional independent virgin episodes can resolve. Frozen mechanism episodes are never consulted.
blind_trigger: Independent matched run from common initialization when measurable history/consequence and timing authority are present and the explicit-material increment requires a control; target the full run's last eligible cumulative count.
evaluation: Use final naturally reached node checkpoint; no retained task selection.

continuation_numeric_conventions.load_signal: Cross-leg after a witnessed actual release; query and subsequent confirmed landing footprints geometrically intersect the physical reloaded cell; past observer owner agrees with previous plant owner and is unloaded at issue. Both free displacement magnitudes exceed 1 nm (1e-6 of the 1 mm domain scale), and observed target load is positive. Distinct plant load IDs counted once. Numeric detectability does not establish benefit.
continuation_numeric_conventions.return_trend_or_uncertainty: At least two naturally ended training episodes in a case; positive second-vs-first-half change or nonzero empirical episode-rate standard error above 1e-6 reward/s. No holdouts and no between-seed inference.
